question: What are the basic components of Portland cement?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CaO, SiO2, Al2O3, Fe2O3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The four essential constituents of ordinary Portland cement in order of decreasing proportions are Lime > Silica > Alumina > Iron oxide.
 
• The following table shows the composition of cement and their properties:

 
 

 
 
**Ingredients**

 
 
 
**Within limit**

 
 
 
**If in excess**

 
 
 

 
 
Lime

 
(62 - 65%)

 
 
 
Controls strength and soundness

 
 
 
Makes the cement unsound and it expands and disintegrates

 
 
 

 
 
Silica

 
(17 - 25%)

 
 
 
 Adds strength to cement, as it forms C2S and C3S

 
 
 
Causes slow setting of cement

 
 
 

 
 
Alumina

 
(3 - 8%)

 
 
 
Provides a quick setting of cement and lowers the clinkering temp

 
 
 
Lowers the strength

 
 
 

 
 
Iron oxide

 
(3 - 4%)

 
 
 
Provides color, hardness, and strength and helps in the fusion of raw material

 
 
 
 

 
 
Magnesia

 
(1 - 3%)

 
 
 
Provides hardness and color Decreases shrinkage

 
 
 
Makes the cement unsound

 
 
 

 
 
Alkalies

 
(0.2 - 1%)

 
 
 
Should be in limit

 
 
 
Alkali aggregate reaction

 
Efflorescence and staining
